gates.acceptance: The runbook names the adapter reporting policy artifact before paid outcomes are interpreted.
Each adapter has cell count, scoreable count, pass rate, repo/split breakouts, policy violations, cost basis, cost per cell, usage observed rate, and median latency.
The report shows both pass, both fail, adapter A only pass, adapter B only pass, and disagreement rate.
